title: Routing
summary: Choose a manual route table or flat files. Both produce the same route objects.

sections.title: Manual paths
sections.body: Static segments match exactly; :id captures one non-empty segment; a terminal * captures the remaining path. One trailing slash is ignored. Query strings do not select routes. First match wins.

sections.title: Flat files
sections.body: The Vite plugin discovers immediate route folders or flat module files. Dots create URL segments, $id creates a parameter, and a terminal $ creates a splat. _index is an index route. Leading underscore segments are pathless; trailing underscores are removed. These are URL conventions, not nested component layouts.

sections.title: Enable the plugin
sections.body: Install Vite 8 or newer. Import the generated route table from the virtual module. Re-export server handlers from separate files so server implementation code can be excluded from browser builds.

sections.title: Limits
sections.body: File routing does not support arbitrary directory nesting, optional segments, parentheses, bracket escapes, or nested layout rendering. Duplicate or ambiguous parameter patterns return an error. Manual ordering remains your responsibility; file discovery sorts static routes ahead of dynamic routes.
